plugins.description: Native Rapid-MLX provider for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — dsh reads model facts from the server instead of your settings.yaml.
plugins.readme_text:
# @raullenchai/dsh-provider

A native [Rapid-MLX](https://github.com/raullenchai/Rapid-MLX) provider for
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) — so `dsh`
gets its model facts from the server instead of from whatever you typed into
`settings.yaml`.

[![CI](https://github.com/raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

> **Status: published to npm** as
> [`@raullenchai/dsh-provider`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@raullenchai/dsh-provider).
> The end-to-end `dsh` run in [Verified](#verified) was on an M3 Ultra against
> `dsh 0.1.0-rc.7`; `dsh 0.1.0-rc.8` is API-compatible — the `LlmAdapter`
> contract is byte-identical and the only changes are additive — and the
> adapter is re-verified against rc.8 at the protocol and unit-test level.
> DSH is still a developer preview that moves fast, so treat this as tracking
> a moving target, not a frozen compatibility promise.

## What it does for you

DSH can already talk to a local Rapid-MLX server through its generic
`openai-completions` provider. That route works — but it knows nothing about
your model beyond what you hand-wrote:

```yaml
# what the generic route makes you maintain, by hand, per model
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    rapid-mlx:
      baseURL: http://localhost:8000/v1
      defaultContextWindow: 262144      # you looked this up. is it still right?
      models:
        - id: qwen3.6-35b-8bit
          contextWindow: 262144
          reasoningEfforts: {off: none, low: low, medium: medium, high: high}
```

Rapid-MLX's `/v1/models` already publishes all of that and more. This adapter
reads it, so:

**1. Nothing to hand-write, and nothing to re-write when you switch models.**
Swap what `rapid-mlx serve` is running and `dsh` follows. No re-running setup,
no stale numbers.

**2. The reasoning control tells the truth.** Rapid-MLX reports whether a model
actually has a reasoning parser. A model that can't reason no longer shows an
off/low/medium/high selector that does nothing.

**3. Compaction is timed with the capacity that actually fits this Mac, not a
number that drifted.** This is the one that quietly costs you.
`dsh-compaction-basic` asks the provider for the route's capacity and compacts
at `thresholdRatio × capacity` (0.8 by default). The provider prefers the
server's **`max_model_len`** — Rapid-MLX's memory-fitted ceiling (what fits in
unified memory: weights + KV cache), in the vLLM/SGLang-standard field — over
the native `context_window`, and falls back to `context_window` on an older
server that doesn't report it. So compaction is timed to what the machine can
actually hold, not the model's advertised window (which it may not have room
for) and not a hand-written number copied from another model.

## Install

Needs Node ≥ 22.15 (dsh imports Node's Zstd stream API without declaring it)
and a running Rapid-MLX server.

```sh
# From npm:
dsh plugin --profile web add @raullenchai/dsh-provider

# …or straight from source — the package ships plain JS with no build step:
dsh plugin --profile web add github:raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider

export RAPID_MLX_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8000/v1     # optional; this is the default
dsh web
```

Then point the agent at the route:

```yaml
# $DSH_HOME/settings.yaml
agent-default-model:
  provider: rapid-mlx
  model: qwen3.6-35b-8bit
```

Verified: that command installs and activates as a profile layer against
`dsh 0.1.0-rc.7`. To hack on it locally instead, see
[Local development](#local-development).

## Model management (v0.2.0)

Beyond the provider route, the plugin registers five tools and a `/rapid-mlx`
command so the agent can see and manage models without leaving the session.
The split follows which surface actually owns each fact: served-model facts
come from the structured HTTP `/v1/models`; the download cache and pull/remove
are CLI-only, so those — and only those — shell out to `rapid-mlx` through the
harness subprocess seam.

| Tool | Source | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `rapid_mlx_serving` | HTTP `/v1/models` | The model(s) served right now, deduped, with context window, reasoning/tool parsers, MoE/hybrid, and modalities. |
| `rapid_mlx_cached` | `rapid-mlx models --cached` | Downloaded models and their on-disk size. |
| `rapid_mlx_pull` | `rapid-mlx pull <name>` | Download a model (alias or HF repo id). Cancellable; no fixed deadline. |
| `rapid_mlx_remove` | `rapid-mlx rm -y <name>` | Delete a cached model to free disk. |
| `rapid_mlx_health` | HTTP + `rapid-mlx --version` | API up? CLI reachable? Reported as two independent facts. |

`/rapid-mlx` prints a one-shot overview: health, the served model and its facts,
and total cache disk usage.

The CLI is resolved from the `cliCommand` config (default `rapid-mlx` on
`PATH`, or `$RAPID_MLX_CLI`); set it to an absolute path if the binary is not on
the harness's `PATH`. `rapid_mlx_pull`/`rapid_mlx_remove` are the only tools
that change anything on disk, and they run non-interactively (`rm` is forced
with `-y` because the subprocess seam ignores stdin).

## Verified

Against `dsh 0.1.0-rc.7` on an M3 Ultra:

- Installs and **activates as a profile layer** (no "declares no `dsh.bundle`"
  warning; the entry shows up in `dsh --profile headless --dump-config`).
- Registers the `rapid-mlx` route with `ctx.llm` and serves real queries.
- Plain chat, a single tool call, and the multi-step bug-fix task that gates
  Rapid-MLX releases — the last one fixed the bug and made the target repo's own
  test pass, verified independently, in 36 s on `qwen3.6-35b-8bit`.

## Not done yet

Being explicit, because the point of the adapter is to *use* what the server
says and some of it is still only read:

- `recommended_sampling` — should be applied automatically per model.
- `tool_call_parser` — should let `dsh` fail fast on a model that cannot emit
  `tool_calls`, instead of looping.
- `is_hybrid` / `is_moe` / `capabilities` — read, not yet acted on.
- **Memory-aware capacity.** Today `resolveModel()` reports the model's
  *advertised* context window. On a Mac the real ceiling is unified memory, and
  reporting that instead is the biggest remaining win — it needs Rapid-MLX to
  expose a usable-capacity figure first.
- Images are not carried through `stream()` — but they now **refuse** with
  `LlmError(..., 'UNSUPPORTED')` rather than being dropped, per the cookbook.
  Text, reasoning and tool calls are carried.
- The route is registered as `rapid-mlx`. If your `settings.yaml` also declares
  a `rapid-mlx` provider under `llm-pi-ai`, the two compete for one route name
  (`registerAdapter` owns provider exclusivity). Use one or rename ours.

## Conformance with the official adapter contract

Built against
[`docs/cookbook/adding-an-llm-adapter.md`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/main/docs/cookbook/adding-an-llm-adapter.md)
and its "protocol obligations" section. Each item has a test:

| Obligation | How it is met |
|---|---|
| `usage` before `finish`, nothing after `finish` | usage is buffered and flushed at end-of-stream, so a trailing usage-only chunk cannot reorder it |
| Tool-call `arguments` are raw JSON strings end to end | fragments stream as `argumentsDelta` and reassemble unparsed |
| Block indexes in first-seen order, reused per block | verified across a reasoning-then-text response |
| Errors take exactly two sanctioned paths | transport/protocol failures **throw** `LlmError` with a stable code; nothing ends the stream quietly |
| Honor `options.signal` | passed to `fetch` and to the SSE reader; an `AbortError` is re-thrown unchanged, not reclassified |
| A field the provider cannot honor throws `UNSUPPORTED` | image content refuses instead of being narrowed away |
| Config is a schemastery schema with env fallback | `export const Config`, fed from `cordis.patch.yml` via `!!js process.env.RAPID_MLX_BASE_URL` |

`finish.replayState` is not emitted: Rapid-MLX needs no native response ids
or signatures on follow-up calls, so there is nothing lossless to project.

plugins.description: Switch DSH's built-in web_search between the DeepSeek Search API (/v1/tools/search) and the default account search, with live fallback, a settings page and a sidebar switch.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-deepsearch

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-plugin-deepsearch)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-deepsearch)
[![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/github-SeaViod%2Fdsh--plugin--deepsearch-181717?logo=github)](https://github.com/SeaViod/dsh-plugin-deepsearch)

Switch DSH's built-in `web_search` between the **DeepSeek Search API** (`POST /v1/tools/search`) and DSH's default account search — with automatic fallback, a settings page, a sidebar switch and a model-facing tool.

English | [中文说明](README.zh.md)

- **ON (`deepseek-api`)** — the built-in `web_search` tool is served by the DeepSeek Search API. This is a paid API: successful requests are billed by DeepSeek; check the current pricing in your DeepSeek console before enabling it.
- **OFF (`builtin`)** — the default DSH route: server-side account search (one search consumes one model turn).
- Switching is **immediate** and survives restarts: the mode is persisted in `$DSH_HOME/deepsearch-mode.json`.
- **It never makes search unavailable.** With no key, a 401, a network error, or 429/5xx retries exhausted, the provider falls back to the previous (or another available) search provider and reports the reason in `lastError`.
- **Zero runtime dependencies** — only `node:` builtins and the global `fetch`. No build step.
- Settings page and sidebar switch are localized in **English and Chinese**.

## What it does

The plugin has two halves that work together:

| Half | File | Responsibility |
|---|---|---|
| Host | `index.js` | Registers the model tool `deepsearch`, registers a search provider (default id `deepseek-search-api`), routes `web.searchProviderId` on/off, exposes four HTTP routes under `/deepsearch/`, and resolves the API key. |
| Browser | `client.js` | Hand-written bundle loaded through `window.__ModuleLoader__.load(...)`: the settings tab and the sidebar footer switch. |

`cordis.patch.yml` is the bundle patch: a `dsh plugin add` or plugin-market install puts the package into the profile's `node_modules` (recorded in the profile `package.json` under `dsh.profile.bundles`), and the bundle layer applies this patch at boot — you do not need to edit the profile patch by hand.

## Three entry points

| Entry point | Where | What it is for |
|---|---|---|
| Settings page | **Settings → Built-in plugins → DeepSeek Search** | switch, status details, endpoint test, API key editor |
| Sidebar switch | Footer of the left sidebar | one-click toggle that shows the current route (`API` / `builtin`) |
| Model tool | `deepsearch` (`status` / `on` / `off` / `search` / `fetch` / `check`) | toggle the route or run a search from a conversation |

## Install

### From the plugin market

Search for **dsh-plugin-deepsearch** (or "DeepSeek Search") in the DSH plugin market and install it. The storefront uses the package's `dsh.bundle.patch`, so the host half is registered automatically. After installing, the new settings tab appears under **Settings → Built-in plugins → DeepSeek Search**; a browser page reload may be needed the first time so the client bundle is picked up.

### From the command line

```pwsh
# Install into the default profile
dsh plugin add dsh-plugin-deepsearch

# Or target a profile explicitly: `web` for a `dsh web` server
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-deepsearch
```

Installing for the **Desktop app** uses the desktop profile / the in-app plugin market UI (the Desktop app keeps its profile under its own DSH home; no user-home path has to be typed by hand). The plugin's browser half declares `dsh.client.platform: "web"`, which is what the desktop shell also loads.

If you are installing from a checkout rather than the registry, `npm pack` the folder and `dsh plugin add` the resulting tarball.

### Upgrading from 0.1.x

0.1.x had no bundle patch; it was installed by hand with one insert row in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: deepsearch
      name: dsh-plugin-deepsearch
```

0.2.0 ships `dsh.bundle.patch` (`cordis.patch.yml` at the package root). A `dsh plugin add` or plugin-market install does **not** write an insert row into the profile patch: it installs the package into the profile's `node_modules`, records it in the profile's `package.json` under `dsh.profile.bundles`, and the bundle layer applies the package's own `cordis.patch.yml` at boot. **Remove the old hand-written insert row before installing 0.2.0 as a bundle** — a leftover hand-written row plus a bundle install would load the plugin twice. Mode and key files under `$DSH_HOME` are kept, so the switch state and the key file survive the upgrade.

The profile name depends on the client: use `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-deepsearch` for a `dsh web` server; the Desktop app uses the `desktop` profile and its plugin-market UI. Do not type a full profile path — let `dsh plugin` resolve it.

### Uninstall

Remove the package from the profile (or uninstall it from the plugin market). The plugin does not add other files to the profile. The state file `$DSH_HOME/deepsearch-mode.json`, the diagnostics file `$DSH_HOME/deepsearch-diag.json` and the optional key file `$DSH_HOME/deepsearch-key.txt` can be deleted, or left in place if you plan to reinstall.

## Configuration

Configuration is read from the `config` block of the plugin's entry in the profile patch, and is normalized so that invalid values fall back to the defaults instead of throwing:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: deepsearch
      name: dsh-plugin-deepsearch
      config:
        apiKeyEnv: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY
        count: 8
        retryCount: 1
```

All keys are optional. The table below matches the host config schema; the `config` block is also what a bundle install can carry.

| Key | Default | Normalisation / meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `apiKey` | `''` | API key given inline. String, trimmed; empty means "unset". Not recommended: it stays in the patch file. Never echoed back by any route. |
| `apiKeyEnv` | `'DEEPSEEK_API_KEY'` | Name of the credentials reference / environment variable to resolve. Must match `/^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$/`, otherwise the default is used. |
| `baseURL` | `'https://api.deepseek.com'` | API base URL. Trimmed; must parse as an `http(s)` URL; trailing slashes are stripped. |
| `searchPath` | `'/v1/tools/search'` | Search endpoint path (appended to `baseURL`). Trimmed, forced to start with `/`; a `?` or `#` rejects the value; empty falls back to the default. |
| `fetchPath` | `'/v1/tools/fetch'` | Page-fetch endpoint path (same rules as `searchPath`). |
| `keyFile` | `''` | Key file for the file-based key. `''` means `$DSH_HOME/deepsearch-key.txt`; `~/...` expands to the home directory; a relative path resolves under `$DSH_HOME`; anything else is used as an absolute path. |
| `count` | `8` | Number of search results. Integer, clamped to 1..50. |
| `needContent` | `false` | Ask the search API for page content (direct `deepsearch search` calls only). Only a strict `true` enables it. |
| `timeoutMs` | `30000` | Timeout per HTTP attempt. Integer, clamped to 1000..120000. |
| `retryCount` | `1` | Extra attempts after the first one (on 408/429/5xx). Integer, clamped to 0..3. |
| `retryDelayMs` | `1200` | Delay between retry attempts. Integer, clamped to 100..10000. |
| `maxFetchChars` | `20000` | Maximum characters returned by `fetch`/the `search` tool when content is requested. Integer, clamped to 1000..200000. |
| `providerId` | `'deepseek-search-api'` | Search provider id to register. Must match `/^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,63}$/` and must not collide with an existing provider, except for the plugin's own re-registration. |
| `fallbackProvider` | `''` | Preferred fallback provider id used when switching OFF. Empty means auto-detect (the previously active provider, then the first available provider that is not ours). |
| `fallbackOnError` | `true` | When the Search API call fails, fall back to another provider. Only a strict `true` enables it. |
| `language` | `'auto'` | `auto` / `en` / `zh`. `auto` resolves from `DSH_LANGUAGE`, `DSH_LOCALE`, `LANG`, `LC_ALL` (Chinese locales map to `zh`, everything else to `en`). |
| `checkQuery` | `'DeepSeek'` | Query used by the "tes

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 插件：上下文超过 45% 且静默 3 分钟时自动压缩会话历史
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-auto-compact

DeepSeek Harness 插件：**上下文占用超过 30%、且对话 3 分钟没有动静时，自动压缩会话历史。**

阈值、静默时长、巡检间隔、冷却时间都可配置。

> **EN** — A DSH host plugin that compacts a session automatically once its context
> usage passes a threshold (30% by default) **and** the conversation has been idle
> for a while (3 minutes by default). Zero runtime dependencies; it only decides
> *when*, and delegates the actual summarization to the official
> `@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic` backend via `/compact`.

## 它解决什么问题

DSH 自带的自动压缩只在“回合进行中、跑到模型上下文阈值（默认 80%）”时才触发。
长会话往往在回合结束时停在 60%~80% 之间，之后你放着不动，下一句话照样要带着
一坨旧历史进请求：首 token 慢、贵，还容易在再聊几轮后直接顶到上限。

这个插件补上“空闲期”这一段：只要某个会话**已经静默够久**，且**上下文占用已过线**，
它就在后台把旧历史压成一条 checkpoint，等你回来时上下文是干净的。

## 判定规则

每个巡检周期（默认 15s）对每个存活会话依次检查：

| 条件 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| `agent.status === "idle"` | 回合正在跑时**绝不**介入，不和进行中的对话抢状态 |
| 静默 ≥ `idleMs` | 会话日志事件、agent 状态变化、收件箱投递都会刷新“最后活跃时间” |
| 上下文 ≥ `thresholdRatio` | 取 token-meter 的上下文投影（与界面显示的百分比同源） |
| 距离上次尝试 ≥ `cooldownMs` | 成功、失败、跳过都计入冷却，避免反复打扰模型 |
| 不在压缩中 | 单个会话同时只允许一次自动压缩 |

命中后调用官方压缩链路，把可压缩的历史压成一条 checkpoint。压缩本身产生的事件
会刷新活跃时间，所以不会连环触发。

## 安装

### 方式一：从 tgz 安装（推荐）

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add file:C:/Plugins/dsh-auto-compact-0.1.0.tgz
```


### 方式二：从源码（GitHub）

```bash
git clone https://github.com/fpm0312/dsh-auto-compact.git
cd dsh-auto-compact
npm pack
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "file:$PWD/dsh-auto-compact-0.1.2.tgz"
```

PowerShell 里最后一行写成：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "file:$((Get-Location).Path)\dsh-auto-compact-0.1.2.tgz"
```

开发调试可以直接用 `link:` 挂目录（改动免重装，但需要重启应用让宿主重新 import）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "link:$PWD"
```

### 方式三：手工挂载（等价）

1. 把本包放进 profile 的依赖里（`~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json`）：
   `"dsh-auto-compact": "file:C:/Plugins/dsh-auto-compact-0.1.0.tgz"`
2. 在同一个文件的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里追加 `"dsh-auto-compact"`。
3. 在 profile 目录执行 `pnpm install`。

本包自带 `cordis.patch.yml`（`dsh.bundle.patch`），安装后会把 `auto-compact`
一行插进配置树，不需要手改 `cordis.patch.yml`。桌面端的 profile 监听会在
`package.json` / patch 变化时热重载插件树；否则重启一次应用即可。

## 配置

配置写在插件行上（profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`，或直接用上面的 `config` 段覆盖）：

```yaml
- id: auto-compact
  name: dsh-auto-compact
  config:
    thresholdRatio: 0.30     # 上下文占用阈值（占模型上下文窗口比例）
    idleMs: 180000           # 静默多久算“没动静”（毫秒）
    pollMs: 15000            # 巡检间隔（毫秒）
    cooldownMs: 300000       # 两次尝试之间的最小间隔（毫秒）
    minTokens: 0             # 低于这个绝对 token 数不压缩
    compactTimeoutMs: 600000 # 单次压缩超时
    dryRun: false            # true = 只记录“本该压缩”，不真的压
    statusFile: true         # 心跳状态文件；false 关闭，或给绝对路径
    via: auto                # auto | service | command
    verbose: true            # 是否输出 info 日志
```


### `via` 是什么

压缩后端挂在**每个 agent preset 的隔离作用域**里，宿主平面拿不到 `ctx.compaction`。
插件按以下顺序找通道：

1. `service`：`agent.ctx.get("compaction")` 能拿到就直接调 `compactNow()`；
2. `command`：拿不到就执行内置的 `/compact` 命令 —— 同一条官方压缩链路，
   会在会话日志里留下 `command/run` + `command/done`，界面上可见。

`auto`（默认）先试 1 再退 2；`service` / `command` 可以强制只走某一条。

## 可观测性

- **心跳文件**：默认 `~/.dsh/auto-compact.status.json`，每次巡检后刷新。里面有每个
  会话的 `totalTokens` / `contextWindow` / `ratio` / `reason` / `lastAction`，
  一眼能看出“为什么这次没压”。
- **命令**：`/autocompact` 查看当前会话的占用与判定；`/autocompact now` 立即评估一次
  （跳过静默等待，但仍受阈值与冷却约束）。
- **日志**：`[auto-compact]` 前缀，info 级汇报压缩结果，warn 级汇报真故障；
  “agent 忙 / 被取消”这类正常竞争只记 info。

## 设计取舍

- **只做决策，不重写压缩**：真正的摘要、写 checkpoint、替换 surface 全部交给
  `@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic`，插件只负责“什么时候该压”。
- **零 `@deepseek-ai/*` 依赖**：安装成 tgz 后不需要解析宿主的 peer 依赖，宿主升级
  也不会因为类型/内部实现变化把插件带崩。
- **空闲优先**：绝不压缩正在跑的回合。压缩是重活（要调一次模型），空闲期做最划算。
- **百分比与界面同源**：优先读 token-meter 的 `contextPressure` 投影
  （`pressureTokens + surfaceTokens - sampledSurfaceTokens`），拿不到才退回
  `measure().totalTokens` 估算。

## 开发

```bash
node --test test/auto-compact.test.mjs   # 16 个用例：决策矩阵 + 假宿主集成
node --check lib/index.js
npm pack                                  # 产出 tgz
```


`test/` 里用假宿主驱动 `apply()`，覆盖：静默判定、阈值边界、运行中不介入、
事件刷新计时、冷却、dryRun、命令兜底、投影优先、心跳文件、`/autocompact`。

## 已知限制

- 只对**空闲**会话生效；回合进行中的压力压缩仍然交给 `compaction-basic` 自己的阈值
  （默认 80%）。两者互补，不冲突。
- 压缩会真实调用一次模型（摘要），会计费；`cooldownMs` 就是为此存在的。
- 如果 profile 里根本没有挂载任何压缩后端，`/compact` 也不存在，插件会如实报
  `missing` 并在心跳文件里留痕，不会静默失败。

# dsh-web-preview

在 DeepSeek Harness 右侧栏里直接预览网页，不用跳出 DSH 去开外部浏览器。

Preview web pages inside the DeepSeek Harness right sidebar — no external browser window needed.

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-green.svg)](LICENSE)
[![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-0.2.0--rc.1%2B-blue.svg)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
[![Topic: dsh-plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/topic-dsh--plugin-0284c7.svg)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)

> 装不上、报错、或者行为和文档对不上，直接发邮件到 **1992335297@qq.com**，比开 Issue 更快被看到。

---

![右侧栏网页预览](docs/preview.png)

> 图为界面示意，按插件 `lib/client.js` 的地址栏与 iframe 布局渲染，不是运行截图。可用 `node scripts/make-screenshots.mjs` 重新生成（源码在 `scripts/demo/preview.html`）。

## 它解决什么问题

写完前端要验证效果，标准流程是切到浏览器、开新标签、输地址、再切回来。真机上窗口一多就找不着北。DSH 的右侧栏本来就是文件预览的地盘，把网页也放进去，视线不用离开对话。

`dsh-web-preview` 给右侧栏加一个「网页预览」标签页：输入地址、回车，页面就在侧栏里跑起来。

## 用法

1. 点右侧栏 tab 条上的添加按钮，在引导页里选 **网页预览**。
2. 在地址栏输入 `localhost:5173` 或 `https://example.com`，回车。
3. 地址栏右侧三个按钮：重新加载、在外部浏览器打开、复制地址。

地址会自动补协议：`localhost:5173` 走 `http://`，裸域名走 `https://`。显式写了协议就按你写的来。

## 实现方式

走 DSH 官方的侧栏扩展点，不自绘面板、不覆盖既有 UI：

- 类型注册：`ctx.sidebarRightTabs.register({ id, kind, patterns, priority, title, guide })`
- 正文注册：`ctx.slots.register({ name: 'sidebar.right.pane.tab', key })`
- 导航：`ctx.sidebarRight.openResource('dsh-resource://web/<encodeURIComponent(url)>')`

每个预览地址是一个独立的资源 tab，同一地址重复打开会聚焦已有 tab，不会堆一堆重复页。tab 标题取目标站点的 host。

宿主侧只提供一个只读健康检查 `/api/web-preview/health`，不读文件、不落盘、没有对外网络请求。

## 安全边界

- iframe 只接受 `http` / `https`，其它协议直接拒绝。
- 拒绝把 DSH 自身的 origin 当作预览目标，避免把 DSH 页面嵌进自己造成同源脚本互扰。
- 不注入任何脚本到被预览的页面，不读取页面内容，不上报任何数据。
- 预览页运行在 iframe 的独立文档上下文里；父页面不获得它的 DOM。

## 已知限制

- 跨域页面无法被父页面读取 DOM，所以这一版只能「看」，不能「批注」。
- 拒绝承载体 X-Frame-Options / CSP `frame-ancestors` 的站点会白屏，这类站点请用地址栏右侧的 ↗ 打开到外部浏览器。
- 需要登录态的页面在侧栏里可能没有 cookie，取决于目标站点的 SameSite 策略。
- 尚未注册模型工具，目前由用户手动输入地址。

## 路线图

批注功能（指向页面元素、显示标签/尺寸/颜色/字体、点击就地下评论、批注回填输入框）二期实现。跨域 iframe 拿不到内部 DOM，二期改为宿主侧接管浏览器：Playwright 打开页面、CDP 推画面、坐标回传、`document.elementFromPoint` 取元素、注入批注覆盖层。

## 开发

```
lib/index.js         宿主侧：健康检查路由 + URL 规范化
lib/client.js        客户端侧：tab 类型注册、正文（地址栏 + iframe）
scripts/verify.mjs   自检
```

```bash
node scripts/verify.mjs
```

覆盖包元数据、patch 结构、客户端语法与依赖声明、同源防护、四类 URL 规范化用例、路由注册与健康检查、非法路由。共 14 项。

## 安装

### 一条命令

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "github:nubeslove/dsh-web-preview"
```

然后在 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/desktop/package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里追加 `"dsh-web-preview"`，重启 DSH。

实测 pnpm 11.9 从 GitHub 直接拉取，3.9 秒装完。插件是纯 JS，没有构建步骤，也没有任何运行时依赖。

### 本地开发

自己改代码时用 link 指向工作副本：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-web-preview"
```

路径含空格时手工处理：在 `profiles/desktop/package.json` 的 `dependencies` 加 `"dsh-web-preview": "link:E:/path/to/dsh-web-preview"`，在 `dsh.profile.bundles` 追加 `"dsh-web-preview"`，并在 `profiles/desktop/node_modules/` 下建指向本目录的 Junction，然后重启 DSH。

## 许可证

[MIT](LICENSE)

## 反馈与联系 / Feedback & Contact

遇到 bug、安装失败、行为和文档不一致，或者想要某个功能，都可以直接发邮件。

**邮箱：1992335297@qq.com**

邮件里带上这三样，定位会快很多：

- 插件版本（`package.json` 里的 `version`）
- DSH 版本（`dsh --version`）
- 报错的完整文字或截图

也可以在 [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/nubeslove/dsh-web-preview/issues) 提，但邮件更快。

# dsh-multi-agent-gateway

**DSH 的多 Agent 通用 API 反代网关 Provider 插件。**

一个插件管起所有「AI Agent 平台」的账号：统一账号管理、每日签到、额度/积分拉取、
活动任务自动执行、多账号智能路由；同时把各平台的模型**按 Agent 分组**上报到 DSH
对话框的**原生模型选择器**，并在每个模型名后标注**积分消耗倍率**。

不是独立 Nginx，也不是外部代理进程 —— 请求全部在插件内部转发，账号凭证加密存在本机。

## 💬 DeepSeek Harness 插件交流群

欢迎加入 **DeepSeek Harness 插件交流 QQ 群**——插件开发、模型接入、推理档位、
第三方厂商配置等话题都可以在这里交流，本插件的问题与建议也欢迎直接进群反馈：

> ## 🐧 QQ 群号：`1105449571`
>
> 打开 QQ → 搜索群号 **1105449571** 即可加入（进群请备注「dsh 插件」）

群内可交流：插件开发经验、模型接入与档位配置、DSH 使用技巧、新功能需求投票等。

---

## 它解决什么

| 你现在的麻烦 | 这个插件怎么办 |
|---|---|
| 有 5 个平台、十几个账号，每个平台一套登录/签到/查额度 | 一个配置页全管起来，按 Agent 分组 |
| 某个号限流了 / 额度用完了，会话当场报错 | 同 Agent 内自动换号重试，用户无感 |
| 每天要手动去点签到、领活动任务积分 | 定时任务自动跑，流水可查 |
| 模型下拉里一堆同名模型，看不出哪个贵 | 按 Agent 分组，后面缀 `(×2)` / `(免费)` |

## 支持情况

| Agent | 状态 | 签到 | 额度 | 模型 | 活动任务 | 对话 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **OpenCode** | ✅ 完整实现 | 取决于上游¹ | ✅ | ✅ | 取决于上游¹ | ✅ 流式 + 思维链 |
| Qoder | 🧩 骨架 | — | — | — | — | — |
| Qoder CN | 🧩 骨架 | — | — | — | — | — |
| Trae | 🧩 骨架 | — | — | — | — | — |
| WorkBuddy | 🧩 骨架 | — | — | — | — | — |
| WorkBuddy International | 🧩 骨架 | — | — | — | — | — |

> ¹ **opencode.ai 官方 Console 没有签到接口，也没有活动任务接口。**
> 这两项是国内反代平台常见的形态，所以本插件把接口路径做成**可配置**的：
> 你填了 `upstream.checkInPath` / `tasksPath` 就真去调；没填就明确回报
> 「上游没有这个接口（这不是故障）」，**绝不伪造签到结果**。
> 详见 [`docs/OPENCODE-API.md`](docs/OPENCODE-API.md)。

### 「免费模型不要 key」——对，插件做到了**一个字段都不用填**

**不登录、不填 API key、不填凭证** —— 账号卡片里只填一个标签就完事，
模型选择器里选 `OpenCode · xxx (免费)` 直接聊。

为什么以前会 403、现在能过：上游那句 `FreeTierError`（*"can only be used from
within OpenCode"*）是**营销话术**，它实际校验的是**请求形状**。消融实验实测出来的
**过门三件事**：

| 条件 | 去掉会怎样 |
|---|---|
| `stream: true` | **403** —— 免费层只接受流式 |
| 请求里有一个叫 `read` 的工具 | **403** |
| 规范的 `x-opencode-session`（`ses_…` 降序编码） | **403** |

其余（`Authorization`、`x-opencode-request`、`x-opencode-project`）**去掉照样过**。

插件在「账号没有 key」时自动补齐这三样（`upstream.freeTierMode: 'auto'` 默认值），
`stream: true` 本来就是它的固定行为，`read` 工具 DSH 本来就发 —— 所以是真的零配置。
机制细节、实测报文、消融表见 [`docs/OPENCODE-API.md`](docs/OPENCODE-API.md) §1.5–1.6。

**实测证据**（`npm run test:free`）：空凭证账号 → 200 → 正文「收到」+
`reasoning_content` + usage，**全程没有任何 key**。

**边界**：匿名通道**只对免费模型有效**；付费模型在它上面会直接
`401 Missing API key`。要用付费模型就走登录/API key。上游随时可能再改门禁 ——
被拒时错误信息会把那三件事列出来，不会让你瞎试。

**另外**：模型目录完全免凭证，所以模型选择器里的分组与倍率
**一个账号都不加也能显示**，只是发不出请求。

「骨架」= 标准化接口**全部实现**，但默认返回「上游不支持」。语义明确、不静默失败；
填上真实的端点与凭证即可工作。扩展方法见 [`docs/EXTENDING.md`](docs/EXTENDING.md)。

## 快速开始

```powershell
# 1) 装进当前 profile（会自动应用 bundle patch）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add D:\AI\DeepseekPlugin\dsh-multi-agent-gateway

# 2) 重启 DSH 桌面端（客户端 bundle 要重新加载）

# 3) 打开 设置 → 插件 → 多 Agent 网关，填账号
```

详细步骤见 [`docs/INSTALL.md`](docs/INSTALL.md)。

## 文档地图

| 文档 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| [`docs/INSTALL.md`](docs/INSTALL.md) | 安装 / 卸载 / 升级 / 目录结构 / 常见安装问题 |
| [`docs/USAGE.md`](docs/USAGE.md) | 添加账号、看积分、配自动任务、调账号路由 |
| [`docs/MODELS.md`](docs/MODELS.md) | 模型分组与倍率标签是怎么进到 DSH 原生选择器的 |
| [`docs/OPENCODE-API.md`](docs/OPENCODE-API.md) | OpenCode 上游的真实接口事实（含核对过的端点表） |
| [`docs/EXTENDING.md`](docs/EXTENDING.md) | **新增一个 Agent 适配器要写什么**（含完整模板） |
| [`docs/ERROR-HANDLING.md`](docs/ERROR-HANDLING.md) | 账号降级、重试规则、任务失败与熔断 |

## 架构（分层模块化）

```
                        ┌──────────────────────── DSH ────────────────────────┐
   对话请求 ──▶ ctx.llm ──▶ src/llm/adapter.ts（每 Agent 一个 provider 路由）
                        │            │                                    │
                        │            ▼                                    │
   模型选择器 ◀───────────│  src/runtime.ts（总装：模型缓存 / 分组 / 倍率标签）   │
                        │            │                                    │
   客户端配置页 ◀─ src/remote.ts ─┼─▶ core/router.ts  多账号路由（换号/降权/恢复）│
                        │            ├─▶ core/scheduler.ts 定时任务管理器    │
                        │            ├─▶ core/tasks.ts  活动任务引擎         │
                        │            └─▶ core/accounts.ts 账号（AES-256-GCM）│
                        │                       │                          │
                        │                       ▼                          │
   工具 ◀────────────────┘            src/adapters/*.ts（每 Agent 一个适配器） │
                        └────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

**新增 Agent 只需要在 `src/adapters/` 加一个文件 + 在 `adapters/index.ts` 加一行。**
核心调度（路由 / 定时 / 任务 / 网关 / UI）一行都不用改。

## 数据落在哪

默认 `<DSH_HOME>/multi-agent-gateway`（`DSH_HOME` 一般是 `~/.dsh`）：

| 文件 | 内容 | 丢了会怎样 |
|---|---|---|
| `.master-key` | AES-256-GCM 主密钥（0600） | **账号密文再也解不开**，要重录 |
| `accounts.enc.json` | 账号与凭证（整份加密） | 要重录账号 |
| `state.json` | 额度缓存、健康、模型缓存、任务游标（明文、无敏感信息） | 重算，无损失 |
| `task-log.jsonl` | 任务执行流水（可删） | 历史记录没了 |

**安全边界（说清楚，不吹）**：密文与密钥分文件，防的是「配置被云同步 / 被 grep 到明文
token / 备份泄露」。它**不是硬件密钥库** —— 能读该目录的本机进程同样能读密钥。

## 开发

```powershell
node scripts/build.mjs      # TypeScript → lib/（零依赖，用 Node 自带的类型擦除）
npm test                    # 单元测试 72 + 客户端契约 15 + 冒烟
node test/live-opencode.mjs # 真机管线：打真实 OpenCode 目录核倍率（需要联网，只读公开接口）
```

改完 `src/` **必须重新构建**（`lib/` 是产物）；改完 `client/` 也要重跑构建，
然后重启 DSH（宿主在启动时扫描 `dsh.client` 声明）。

### 已验证

| 验证 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| `node scripts/build.mjs` | 26 个 TS 文件 → `lib/`，零不可擦除语法 |
| 单元测试 | **72/72** 通过 |
| 客户端契约测试 | **15/15** 通过（端点、描述符、volatile 路径、真 `apply(ctx)`、**无参端点零参数**、真渲染 ModelList） |
| 假宿主冒烟 | 通过（provider 路由 / 5 个工具 / **模型上报策略真的改变选择器内容** / 密文落盘） |
| **真机免费层**（`npm run test:free`，联网） | **空凭证账号 → 200 → 正文「收到」+ 思维链 + usage，全程零 key** |
| 真机管线（`npm run test:live`，联网） | 真实模型目录 + 倍率；设备码登录实测发起成功、未授权正确返回 `pending` |
| 真实 DSH 进程（headless profile） | 通过（**零 `did not activate`、零配置校验错误**） |
| **真实浏览器**（Edge + 真 web profile） | 通过 —— 客户端 bundle 在 boot combo 里、`apply` 正常激活、控制台零本插件错误 |

### 模型不是全塞进去：默认只报**免费**的

上游实测 85 个模型，全进下拉的话免费那几个会被淹没。所以每个 Agent 有一份上报策略
（设置页里就是三个按钮 + 一个带搜索的勾选列表）：`free`（默认）/ `selected` / `all`。
详见 [`docs/MODELS.md`](docs/MODELS.md) §6.5。

## 📣 加入交流

对 DeepSeek Harness 插件开发、多 Agent 网关接入感兴趣？欢迎加入交流群一起讨论：

**QQ 群：`1105449571`**（QQ 内搜索群号即可加入，进群请备注「dsh 插件」）

plugins.description: Background sidecar subagents for the DeepSeek Harness: unique names, separate cwd/git-worktree spaces, review-on-demand results.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-sidecar

Fire focused subagents in the background with unique names and separate spaces,
then review each result — task, answer and evidence trail, plus the full
transcript on demand — on your own schedule. **Separate plugin**: no shared state with `dsh-autocontinue`
(continuation/restarts) or the `dsh-update` updater.

## Commands and tools

```sh
/sidecar <task>                              # auto name (sidecar-1, -2, ...), parent cwd
/sidecar --name alpha <task>                 # unique name, pinned as the child session title
/sidecar --cwd /tmp/alpha-space <task>       # separate working directory
/sidecar --worktree --name wt-fix <task>     # isolated git worktree + branch sidecar/wt-fix
/sidecar list                                # running sidecars: name, id, age, cwd
/sidecar result <id>                         # read and consume a stored result now
/sidecar log <id>                            # full child transcript on demand
/sidecar cancel <id>                         # interrupt one
```

Multiple sidecars run concurrently up to the subagents service cap
(`maxActiveSubagents`, default 8). Each gets a unique name (requested names are
suffixed `-2`, `-3`, ... if taken), a distinct child session id, and its title
pinned to the name so the GUI list is unambiguous. They share the parent cwd by
default; use `--cwd` for a separate workspace or `--worktree` for a real
filesystem/branch isolation. Worktrees start from `HEAD` — uncommitted parent
changes are intentionally not visible there.

Model-facing tools (used when the parent chooses to review):

- `sidecar_result` — `{ id }` returns the stored review body and removes it
  from the queue.
- `sidecar_list` — lists stored results waiting for review.

## Delivery: notice, not a queued user message

The child is spawned through `ctx.subagents.startActivation()` with
`delivery: 'caller'`; its prompt forbids `send_message` and further delegation.

When it finishes, the plugin:

1. stores the full result at
   `~/.dsh/sidecar/results/<parent>/<child>.json`;
2. calls `agent.inject(notice)` — a **next-step notice with no wake**. This is
   not `followup`: it does not create a queued user message and does not start a
   turn. A running parent sees it at its next step; an idle parent sees it when
   it next runs. The notice says only that the result is stored and that
   `sidecar_result` will return it;
3. never injects the full result into the transcript. The parent reviews by
   calling `sidecar_result` (or the user runs `/sidecar result <id>`), which
   returns the result as a **tool result** and consumes the file.

The stored review is deliberately compact:

- the **complete task** the sidecar was given (so the parent knows what the
  result is for),
- the **final answer**,
- a **compact evidence trail**: every tool call and its result, in order
  (capped at 8 KB), and
- the **child session id** with a pointer to `sidecar_log`.

The child's complete session log — including workspace instructions, reasoning
and every step — stays on disk. `sidecar_log` (or `/sidecar log <id>`) returns
it on demand. Pushing the full raw log into the parent by default would bury the
useful task/answer under pages of workspace boilerplate, so it is opt-in.

If the parent closes before ever seeing the notice, the file persists; the next
time that parent agent is created (session reopened or resumed) the notice is
injected again. `sidecar_list` is the discovery path if the notice was already
consumed or missed.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:kenjoe41/dsh-sidecar
# or pin a release
dsh plugin --profile web add github:kenjoe41/dsh-sidecar#v0.4.0
```

For a local checkout, link it instead; a linked install needs
`node_modules/@deepseek-ai/{dsh-llm,dsh-tools}` shims so the profile's peers
resolve. Reload or restart the profile after installing.

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-gui-control

给 DSH 的 Web GUI 加两个控制动作：**强刷界面** 与 **重启 Harness**，三处入口共用同一套实现。

- **会话头右上角**：两个 24px 图标按钮，排在官方那三个按钮（在应用中打开 / 会话日志「更多」/ 右栏展开）
  左侧，中间多留 8px 空隙。图标态没有文字，语义在 `aria-label` / `title` 上；重启武装时图标转红并在
  下方浮出提示气泡（绝对定位，不推动这一排）。
- **侧边栏底部**：两个一键入口（展开态是「图标 + 文字」整行，收起态是 32px 图标按钮）。
- **设置 → 界面控制**：运行状态（插件版本 / Host pid / 已运行时长 / 平台 / Profile）、两个动作和说明。

三处入口调用的是同一对函数（`hardReload()` / `restartHarness()`），不存在第二套实现。

## 两个动作分别解决什么

| | 强刷界面 | 重启 Harness |
|---|---|---|
| 做什么 | 清空 `CacheStorage`、注销 Service Worker，然后整页重载，重新拉取并执行每个客户端插件 bundle | 通过 DSH Desktop 的 preload 桥（`window.dshDesktop.restartHarness` → 主进程 IPC `harness:restart`）重启 Host 进程，然后重新加载页面 |
| 什么时候用 | 改了客户端插件（`lib/client.js`）没生效；界面卡在旧的插件列表；样式错乱 | 改了 Host 侧（node 半侧）代码；安装/升级了插件；需要重新加载 Profile |
| 影响 | 只重载这一页，Host 进程不动 | Host 重启，**正在运行的任务会被中断** |
| 可用范围 | 任意载体（桌面端 / 浏览器） | 仅 DSH Desktop 桌面窗口（浏览器里按钮禁用并说明原因） |

重启是破坏性动作，所以做成**两步确认**：第一次点击只「武装」（设置页/侧边栏里按钮变成「确认重启？」并转红，会话头里图标转红并浮出提示），4 秒内再点一次才真的执行，超时自动取消。不用原生 `confirm()`——它会阻塞渲染进程。

## 为什么强刷不是 Ctrl+F5 的严格等价物

页面脚本无法改变文档自身的 cache 模式，所以浏览器层面的「硬刷新」标志拿不到。但本 GUI 会陈旧的三处来源都被覆盖了：

1. `CacheStorage` 里的缓存条目（逐个删除）；
2. 残留的 Service Worker（逐个 `unregister()`）；
3. 客户端模块 factory 的进程内记忆（整页重载即清空）。

插件 bundle 的 URL 自带 `rev=`，Host 侧按 revision 缓存字节，因此重载后拿到的一定是最新产物——这也意味着通常「重载」就够，清缓存是保险。

## 安装

三种方式效果相同（都会写进 `profiles/<profile>/package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`）：

### 1. 从 GitHub 仓库装（推荐）

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add github:ccccwwwxx/dsh-gui-control
```

`lib/client.js` 已随仓库提交，安装时无需构建。

### 2. 从 Release 预构建包装（免构建、免 `allowBuilds` 授权）

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/ccccwwwxx/dsh-gui-control/releases/latest/download/dsh-gui-control.tgz
```

### 3. GUI / 本地目录（开发时用）

**设置 → 插件 → 添加插件**，填本地目录的绝对路径；插件页的安装动作就是 `pluginManager.installBundle`：
先在 `.generations/staging` 里装好、逐层校验，再提升为一代（`dsh-gui-control+<version>+<hash>`）并写进 profile manifest。

卸载：`dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-gui-control`。

### 安装之后

- **首次安装**：客户端半侧随 HMR 直接生效（会话头右上角与侧边栏底部立刻出现两个入口）；没出现就点一次「强刷」。
- **升级安装**：插件管理器会报告 `application: "restart-required"`——新一代 Host 代码要重启才加载，
  正好用插件的「重启」按钮（或菜单里的 Restart Harness）完成，然后页面会重新加载。

## 开发

```powershell
npm run build     # src/client/*.js -> lib/client.js（注入 lib/text.js 的文案）
npm run verify    # 15 项自验：产物新鲜度、bundle 契约、槽位注册、渲染、三处入口的动作、文案对齐
```

`lib/client.js` 是**构建产物**，不要手改：改 `src/client/*.js` 或 `lib/text.js`，然后 `npm run build`。
`npm run verify` 会把重新构建的结果与已提交的 `lib/client.js` 逐字节比对，忘了 build 会直接失败。

### 目录

```
cordis.patch.yml        Loader 条目（插入 dsh-gui-control）
lib/index.js            node 半侧：只读状态 RPC（版本 / pid / 运行时长）
lib/text.js             zh / en 文案，唯一维护处
lib/client.js           构建产物（window.__ModuleLoader__.load(...) 格式）
src/build-client.mjs    拼接 + 注入文案
src/client/00-shared.js 常量、RPC、强刷/重启动作、样式
src/client/10-footer.js 侧边栏两个入口
src/client/15-header.js 会话头右上角两个图标按钮（两步确认 + 提示气泡）
src/client/20-settings.js 设置页区块
src/client/90-apply.js  注册槽位
scripts/verify.mjs      自验
```

### 槽位契约

| 槽 | 类型 | 注册项 | owner 传入 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `conversation.session.header.utilities` | list / session | `gui-control-header-refresh`(-40)、`gui-control-header-restart`(-39) | — |
| `sidebar.footer.action` | list / root | `gui-control-refresh`(71)、`gui-control-restart`(72) | `{ wide }` |
| `settings.section` | list / root | `gui-control`(96) | — |

会话头的 order 用负数是为了排在官方那三个按钮左侧（`open-in-app` 是 -10，会话日志「更多」默认 0）；
`restart` 带 `margin-right:8px`，在容器自带的 8px gap 之外再多留一点空隙。

样式只用主题变量（`--dsw-alias-*`）并带兜底值，类名固定 `dsh-gui-` 前缀，不依赖构建哈希。

## 已知边界

- **Host 侧没有、也不该有「重启自己」的口子**：那是桌面壳的进程监督职责。浏览器版没有重启能力，按钮会禁用并说明。
- **强刷不等价于浏览器的硬刷新标志**（见上）。
- **状态里的「Host 已运行时长」是模块加载时刻起算**，不是操作系统进程的创建时间；两者在正常启动下几乎相同。
- 重启会中断正在运行的任务与工具调用，这是 Host 重启的固有代价，不是插件的选择。

plugins.description: Floating overlay that surfaces pending approvals, plan reviews and user questions from any session, with click-through to the session.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-approval-watch

Global approval / question reminder overlay for DeepSeek Harness (DSH).

When any session has a pending tool approval, a plan review, or a user question, a persistent floating overlay pops up at the bottom-right of the DSH web UI (draggable, collapsible). Clicking an entry jumps straight to the session that needs you, so approvals never stall the flow because they are out of sight.

## How it works

- The host half (`lib/index.js`) is intentionally empty — all behavior lives in the browser half (`lib/client.js`), which registers a shell overlay entry.
- The `dsh.client` manifest injects the browser half into the web client runtime.

## Install

Install it from the **DSH Plugin Market** (Settings → Plugin Market), or add it to your profile bundle stack manually — see `cordis.patch.yml`. Prebuilt; no build step required.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) plugin: edit an already-sent user prompt and resend it - forks a child session whose inherited prefix stops just before that message.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-edit-resend

**改掉已经发出去的那句话，然后重新问一遍。**

[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（DSH）Web GUI 的客户端插件：
给消息操作条加一个 ✏️ 按钮，把某条已发送的用户提示词改掉、分叉重发。

![编辑并重发对话框](docs/dialog.png)

---

## 为什么需要它

DSH 没有「编辑已发送的用户消息并重新生成」这个功能，这是**架构决定的**，不是漏做：
会话是一份 append-only 的事件日志（`session.v4.jsonl` + 崩溃检查点），任何已经落盘的
`user/message` 都不能被原地改写。目前消息上能做的操作只有 **复制** 和 **在新对话中分支**。

本插件补上语义上最接近的等价物：

1. 读出某个已完成轮次开头那条用户提示词（文本 + 事件 seq）；
2. `sessions.fork({ atSeq: seq - 1 })` —— 分叉出一个子会话，其继承前缀正好停在这条提示词之前；
3. 打开子会话，把编辑后的文本作为新提示词发给它。

**原会话完全不动**：不改历史、不改标题、不留痕迹。

## 用法

在任意已完成轮次的底部操作条里点铅笔图标，位置是 `复制 → 👍 → 👎 → ✏️ → 分支`：

![按钮位置](docs/button.png)

- 弹出的对话框预填该轮次的原始提示词，直接改；
- 点「分叉并发送」，界面自动跳到新会话，新提示词已经在跑。

下图的子会话就是分叉出来的：上面那个空的「已完成」是切点留下的合成收尾（见
[已知取舍](#已知取舍)），然后是改写后的提示词和模型的新回复。

![结果](docs/result.png)

按钮只在轮次开头确实是用户提示词、且该提示词之前还有事件（`seq > 0`）时可用；
通知唤醒、命令触发的轮次上按钮是灰的，悬停会说明原因。

## 安装

DSH 插件按 profile 安装。以桌面版默认 profile 为例：

```powershell
$profile = "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop"
git clone https://github.com/stefanydevitoqz-creatorPPP/dsh-edit-resend.git "$profile\plugins\dsh-edit-resend"
```

在 `$profile\package.json` 的 `dependencies` 里加一行：

```json
"dsh-edit-resend": "file:plugins/dsh-edit-resend"
```

在 profile 目录里安装：

```bash
pnpm install
```

> 桌面版自带 pnpm，可以这样调：
> `& "<DSH>\resources\runtime\pnpm\bin\pnpm.mjs" install`
> （用 `resources\runtime\primary-runtime\...\node.exe` 跑，或任何 ≥ 8 的 pnpm）

最后让它挂载：**重启 DSH**，或者在侧栏的**插件**页面里把 `dsh-edit-resend` 打开
（市场对纯客户端插件是热挂载的，不用重启；浏览器刷新一次即可看到按钮）。

> ⚠️ **不要**在 `cordis.patch.yml` 里用裸包名手动加这一行。loader 解析插件入口时是从宿主
> 闭包出发往上找 `node_modules`，走不到 profile 目录，裸包名会解析失败。市场写入的是绝对
> `file://` URL —— 那才是对的做法。

## 卸载

1. 从 `$profile\package.json` 的 `dependencies` 删掉 `"dsh-edit-resend"` 那一行；
2. 在 `$profile` 里跑一次 `pnpm install`；
3. 删掉 `$profile\plugins\dsh-edit-resend` 与 `$profile\node_modules\dsh-edit-resend`。

## 工作原理

| 环节 | 做法 |
| --- | --- |
| 挂载点 | ui-chat 声明的 `conversation.chat.assistant-actions`（`list` / session 作用域）。每条已定稿的助手消息都会渲染该条目，owner prop 是 `{ messageId }`，组件另外拿到 `useChat` / `sessionId` / `t` 等框架 share |
| 定位提示词 | 用 `messageId` 在 `useChat` 快照的 `timeline.turns` 里反查轮次号，再 `locations.getTurn(turn)` + `nodes.get(key)` 找该轮第一个 `kind === 'user'` 节点，取 `data.seq` 与 `data.content` |
| 分叉 | `ctx.get('sessions').fork({ sessionId, atSeq: seq - 1, increaseTitle: true })`。`atSeq` 是**闭区间**切点，所以 `seq - 1` 恰好排除掉这条提示词 |
| 发送 | `sessions.using(childId, { source }, ref => …)` 拿到子会话 binding，经 `binding.ctx.get('conversation').sendSession(binding.session, text, [], 'queue')` 提交 —— 和输入框走完全相同的宿主准入路径（含本地提交回显） |
| 依赖 | 只 `require('react')` 和 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`（两者都在平台 module seed 里），样式用 DSW CSS 变量自绘，**零非基线外部依赖** |

文件很小：`lib/index.js` 是宿主半边的空 `apply()`（只为让包出现在 loader 里），
`lib/client.js` 是全部逻辑。

## 已知取舍

- **不是原地编辑**：产物是**新会话**。这是 append-only 日志下能做到的上限。
- **子会话会多一个空的「已完成」尾巴**：切点落在该轮 `turn/start` 与 `user/message` 之间，
  属于宿主**明确支持**的「在未结束轮次内截取」，它会补上合成的结束事件。这是切点的忠实
  表现，不影响上下文正确性。
- **刻意不切更早**：切到 `turn/start` 之前，会把携带原提示词的 `agent/inbox/spliced` 插入
  事件一起继承过来，而它的移除事件不会跟着继承 —— 子会话的输入队列里就会残留一条待处理
  消息。切在 `seq - 1` 保证队列是干净的。
- **附件不搬运**：原消息若含图片/文件，对话框会提示；v1 只搬文本。

## 开发

宿主加载的是 `node_modules/` 里的**副本**，不是 `plugins/` 里的源码。改完源码后：

```powershell
Copy-Item "$profile\plugins\dsh-edit-resend\lib\client.js" `
          "$profile\node_modules\dsh-edit-resend\lib\client.js" -Force
```

再让市场重新挂载（插件页关掉再打开），浏览器刷新一次。

## 许可

MIT © 2026 stefanydevitoqz-creatorPPP

---

## English summary

A client-side plugin for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
(DSH) Web GUI that gives you the closest honest equivalent of *"edit a sent message and regenerate"*.

DSH cannot rewrite history: a session is an append-only event log, so a durable `user/message` is
immutable. This plugin instead reads the opening user prompt of a completed turn, forks a child
session whose inherited prefix stops immediately before that prompt
(`sessions.fork({ atSeq: seq - 1 })`), opens it, and submits your edited text as its new prompt
through the very same host admission path the composer uses. The original session is never touched.

A pencil button appears in the turn action strip (`copy → 👍 → 👎 → ✏️ → branch`) and the dialog is
prefilled with the original prompt.

Most notable limitation: the result is a **new session**, never an in-place edit, and the child
inherits a small synthetic "completed" turn tail from the cut point (the plugin deliberately cuts at
`seq - 1` rather than before `turn/start`, so the child's input queue stays clean).

MIT licensed.

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: inject a body-level extra_headers entry into OpenAI-compatible chat/completions requests for listed providers and upstream hosts (the only injection point that survives a LiteLLM relay).
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-litellm-extra-headers

给 DeepSeek Harness 用的宿主插件：把 `extra_headers: { "<header>": "<value>" }` 塞进 **OpenAI 兼容请求的 body**，只对「配置里列出的 provider 路由」+「配置里列出的上游 host」生效。

用途：绕过 LiteLLM 之类的反向代理丢弃客户端 HTTP 头的问题——某些上游（例如 OpenCode / 网关自建的会话亲和）要求每个请求带 `x-opencode-session`，而代理只在 `body.extra_headers` 里认这个字段。

简体中文 | [English summary](#english-summary)

## 为什么只能这么做（已核实，改动前先读）

1. **客户端 HTTP 头在 LiteLLM 这一跳被丢弃。** 实测把 `x-opencode-session` 加在请求头上，上游仍然 500；改放 `body.extra_headers` 后 200。
2. **DSH 的 `llm-pi-ai` 适配器只白名单转发** `temperature` / `maxTokens` / `sessionId` / `signal` / `headers` / … 这些字段（见其 `profileOptions()`），pi-ai 唯一能塞任意 body 字段的入口 `options.samplingParams` 在 DSH 里没有暴露，所以纯配置解决不了。
3. **现成的 `dsh-opencode-session` 插件是「加 HTTP 头」的**，在这条链路上注定无效；而且它的默认 `providers` 是 pi-ai 目录里的 `['opencode', 'opencode-go']`，不含自定义路由键（如 `gwds`、`go`）。
4. **pi-ai 的 `openai-completions` 走官方 `openai` SDK**（v6.40.0），SDK 通过 `this.fetch = options.fetch ?? globalThis.fetch` 调用 `globalThis.fetch`。因此运行时替换 `globalThis.fetch` 是当前唯一可用的宿主侧注入点。

结论：**不要在别处再加 header**，那条路已经验证过是死的；要新字段就往 body 里合。

## 安装

已发布在 npm：`dsh-litellm-extra-headers@0.1.0`

```sh
# npm（推荐）
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-litellm-extra-headers

# 从本地目录（开发时推荐，link 安装，改动即时生效）
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-litellm-extra-headers
# 从打包产物
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-litellm-extra-headers-0.1.0.tgz
# 从 git 主机（本包是纯 JS，无需 pnpm 放行构建脚本）
dsh plugin --profile web add github:chenyifawan-cell/dsh-litellm-extra-headers
```

包内 `cordis.patch.yml` 会插入一行插件；`dsh plugin add` 识别到 `dsh.bundle` 后自动把本包加进该 profile 的 `bundles` 列表。装完确认一层存在：

```sh
dsh --profile web --dump-config | Select-String litellm-extra-headers
```

不想装包也可以手工把这一行写进 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`（行指向本包名或 `index.js` 路径）。包内自带的这一行 `providers` / `hosts` **默认留空**（空列表 = 插件保持惰性），把你的路由键和上游地址填进去才生效：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: litellm-extra-headers
      name: dsh-litellm-extra-headers
      config:
        providers: [gwds, go]                # 你的路由键
        hosts: ["litellm.internal:4000"]     # 只有这些上游才注入
        header: x-opencode-session
        mode: session-id
        value: null
        debug: false
        debugFile: null
```

## 配置字段

| 字段 | 类型 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `providers` | `string[]` | `[]` | `llm/stream` 的 `options.provider` 路由键白名单。**必须显式列出**，匹配大小写不敏感。 |
| `hosts` | `string[]` | `[]` | 允许注入的上游 `host[:port]` 白名单；带 scheme / path 的写法会被归一化（`http://litellm.internal:4000/v1` → `litellm.internal:4000`）。**必须显式列出**。 |
| `header` | `string` | `x-opencode-session` | 放进 `extra_headers` 的字段名。 |
| `mode` | `session-id` \| `uuid` \| `fixed` | `session-id` | 取值来源：DSH 会话 id（跨轮次、跨重启稳定）／每会话一个进程内随机 uuid／配置里的字面量。 |
| `value` | `string` | — | `mode: fixed` 时的字面量；`fixed` 却没给值会在加载时报错。 |
| `debug` | `boolean` | `false` | 每次注入决策打一条 `ctx.logger.info`。 |
| `debugFile` | `string` | — | 每次注入决策追加一行 JSON（含 provider / model / session / host / path / event / reason），进程控制台看不到时用它排错。 |

`providers` 或 `hosts` 为空时插件**保持惰性**并打一条 warning：一个可以共享出去的包，不应该对别人没被告知过的网关偷偷加字段。

## 设计要点

1. **双层匹配，缺一不可。**
   - `llm/stream` waterfall 里判断 `options.provider ∈ providers` 且存在 `options.sessionId`，才把 `{ value, provider, model, session }` 放进 `AsyncLocalStorage`（这一步才有路由键）。
   - `fetch` patch 里再判断目标 URL 的 `host ∈ hosts` 才改 body。
   - 于是别人路由键跟你不同时，只会改白名单里的网关，不会给别人的网关塞未知字段。
2. **只改 `/chat/completions` 的 JSON body。** 条件是 `method === 'POST'` + `content-type` 含 `application/json` + `typeof init.body === 'string'` + `pathname` 以 `/chat/completions` 结尾。解析失败一律原样放行；`extra_headers` 已存在时**合并而不覆盖**，已有同名字段时尊重调用方、不覆盖。
3. **零依赖 + 可还原。** 只用 `node:async_hooks` / `node:crypto` / `node:fs/promises`；安装与卸载都是 `ctx.effect()`，dispose 时 `globalThis.fetch` 按引用还原（被别人又包了一层也不会误还原）。

## 验证

```sh
npm test          # node --test：条目命中 / 非命中 / 已存在不覆盖 / 非 JSON 原样 / dispose 还原（19 项）
npm run test:e2e  # 真机链路：本地 mock 上游 + 真实 dsh headless 跑一轮，对照组不带插件
```

按顺序，前一步不过不进下一步：

1. `npm test` 全绿。
2. `npm run test:e2e`：起一个会记录请求体的本地 OpenAI 兼容上游，用 `dsh --profile headless --patch` 把 provider 指向它并挂上本插件，跑一轮真实会话。断言：命中的请求 body 里多出 `extra_headers`、值在整轮里稳定（同一个会话 id）、**对照组（去掉插件行）没有这个字段**，并且 `debugFile` 有 `event: "inject"` 记录。
3. **换到能连到 LiteLLM 的那台机器上**（第 2 步用的是本地 mock 上游，不需要网络）再跑一轮，用 `debugFile` 确认日志里出现注入记录，且上游不再报缺少会话头。这一步验证的是 LiteLLM 自己的「body.extra_headers → 上游请求头」合并行为，只有真实网关能证明。
   对照实验：手动 `curl` 只带 HTTP 头、不带 `extra_headers` → 上游报错；body 里带 `extra_headers` → 通过。

## 发布备忘（首次发布踩过的坑）

1. **2FA 必须开**：npm 只支持安全密钥（Windows Hello 指纹/PIN 或 YubiKey），没有 Google Authenticator 那种 TOTP。
2. **`npm publish` 要在真终端里跑**：npm 只在 stdin/stdout 都是 TTY 时才走「自动开浏览器 → 轮询授权 → 自动重试上传」那条路（`lib/utils/auth.js` 的 `otplease`）；管道化的非交互进程会直接抛 EOTP，而错误文本里的授权 URL 被 `@npmcli/redact` 打码，等于拿不到链接。
3. **新包名会先进审核**：首次发布会先在 registry 上生成一个 `0.0.0-stage` 占位版本（"Temporary package placeholder for staged publishing"），真正的版本进入审核，CLI 只提示 `Your package is being processed`。几分钟后正式版本自动上线，`latest` 指向它，占位版留在历史里。期间 `npm stage list` 可能为空，不用慌。
4. 发布前记得 `--registry=https://registry.npmjs.org`：本机若把 registry 指向 npmmirror 这类只读镜像，默认 `npm publish` 会打错源。

## 已知边界

- `input` 是 `Request` 对象时（body 在 Request 里，同步读不出来）不改，原样放行；当前 pi-ai + openai SDK 走的是「URL 字符串 + init.body 字符串」，不触发这条。
- `extra_headers` 存在但不是普通对象（数组 / 字符串等）时原样放行，避免把别人的 body 改坏。
- 只注入，不做重试、不改 header、不改其它 body 字段。

## English summary

Host plugin for DeepSeek Harness: while a model call routed to a configured provider streams, `globalThis.fetch` merges `extra_headers[<header>] = <value>` into the JSON body of `POST .../chat/completions` requests sent to a configured upstream host. It exists because a LiteLLM relay drops client HTTP headers (verified: header-only 500, body `extra_headers` 200), DSH's pi-ai adapter whitelists request fields, and the existing `dsh-opencode-session` plugin only sets a header. Both `providers` and `hosts` must be listed explicitly, or the plugin stays inert. MIT.

## License

MIT

plugins.readme_text:
DSH Crew

A DeepSeek Harness plugin: dispatch work to DSH agents from Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok, without giving up the host's native subagent UI.
Native Progress UI • Tier Policy & Escalation • Dispatch Guardrails • Jobs Board • In-Host DSH Sessions • Vision & Image Gen (Native-First) • One-Click Install

npm: @zseven-w/dsh-crew · Current plugin release: 0.1.0-rc.11 · Tested with DSH 0.1.1-rc.1

English · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Français · Español · Deutsch · Português · Русский · हिन्दी · Türkçe · ไทย · Tiếng Việt · Bahasa Indonesia


The DSH Crew settings page — host integrations, dispatch policy, execution and the multimodal bridge

## Why DSH Crew DSH Crew is a plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) — an open-source agent harness. It makes DSH agents dispatchable from Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity and Grok: the orchestrator keeps its own model, the work runs on a real DSH agent with that harness's tools, sandbox, presets and session history, and the host still shows it as a native subagent with live progress. What runs the work is a DSH agent, not a bare model call. Tiers (`flash` / `pro`) select how much capability that agent gets from the harness's configured roster — DeepSeek V4 Flash and V4 Pro today — so a change of model in DSH needs no change here.
### 🧵 Native Progress UI Workers appear as regular subagents in Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok — dispatch count, running step, tool calls and token usage all show up in the host's own task panel, plus a claude-hud statusline segment: `⚙dsh 1▶pro 2m14s 21.7k/606 ✓3`. ### 🎚️ Tier Policy and Escalation `flash` for mechanical work, `pro` for reasoning, `effort` from `off` to `max`. `tier_policy` can clamp every dispatch to one tier at the tool layer, and `escalate_on_failure` retries a failed flash run once on pro — based on evidence, not on guessing difficulty up front.
### 🏛️ In-Host DSH Sessions With the bundle installed in a DSH profile, each worker is a first-class DSH session: visible in the Web UI, grouped by working directory, mounted with the Agent preset you choose per tier. Without DSH running, dispatch falls back to a standalone DSH runtime, so CI and headless environments still work. ### 👁️ Vision and Image Generation DSH's models are text-only. `describe_image` now prefers DeepSeek's own VL model (`deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp`) whenever a key is available, then falls back to the CLIs you already have — Claude, Codex, Grok, Antigravity — or any OpenAI-compatible API you configure. `generate_image` borrows the same CLIs' brush. Pasted images stay visible in the conversation and reach the model as text.
### 🛡️ Dispatch Guardrails Every dispatch is checked before anything spawns. Worker→worker nesting is capped at origin-chain depth 3 and cycles are refused; a second worker on a workspace another job already holds is refused with the holder's info — never silently queued. Refusals are readable errors: wait or re-scope, don't bypass. ### 📋 Jobs Board The DSH Crew panel doubles as a jobs board: every worker job — running or finished — is listed with tier, effort, live progress and tokens, held workspaces show their holders, and a job that vanishes mid-flight (e.g. a hub restart) is surfaced as an orphan ghost instead of disappearing silently.
### 🔌 Custom Providers Bring your own endpoint (Base URL + API key + models) or a local command template. Each provider has a connectivity test that checks reachability and auth, then makes one real vision call so you find out now, not mid-task. ### 📦 One-Click Install The settings page installs and updates the Claude Code plugin, the Codex role files and the Antigravity / Grok agents, skills and commands for you — marketplace registration, permission allowlist, HUD wiring, absolute paths rendered for this machine — and restores them just as easily. Every settings file is backed up first.
## How it works ``` Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok (orchestrator, keeps its own model) └─ ds-flash / ds-pro ← native subagent shell (progress shows in the host's task UI) └─ MCP: dsh_run_worker(tier, effort, cwd, worker=) ├─ worker="agy"/"grok" → that external CLI runs the task (explicit opt-in) ├─ hub reachable → session inside DSH (visible in the Web UI, grouped by cwd) └─ otherwise → dsh-jsonrpc-agent runtime (worker.cordis.yml) └─ DeepSeek V4 Flash / Pro (DSH SDK, event stream → progress and token stats) ``` ## One run, two views Dispatch fans out. Below, eighteen workers translate this README in parallel: the host counts them as its own subagents, while the harness runs them as real sessions.

Claude Code sees dsh-crew workers as native subagents, with a statusline segment tracking running tiers, elapsed time and tokens.

The DSH Crew panel sees the same run from the harness side: which host dispatched each job, its tier and effort, live progress and token usage.

The panel is also the jobs board: running and finished jobs stay listed with tier, progress and tokens, held workspaces name their holders, and a job that vanishes mid-flight (a hub restart) surfaces as an orphan ghost instead of disappearing silently.

## Install Install into a DSH profile from npm: ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add @zseven-w/dsh-crew@latest dsh web ``` Or, for local development straight from the source tree: ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-crew dsh web ``` The `link:` protocol symlinks the profile dependency to this repository, so rebuilds are visible immediately. ### Configure DeepSeek credentials (standalone only) In hub mode — the installation above — workers run inside the DSH instance and use the DeepSeek credentials it is already configured with. Nothing else to set up. Only the standalone fallback needs a key of its own: dispatching from a host with no DSH instance running launches a worker runtime as a separate process. Obtain an API key from [platform.deepseek.com](https://platform.deepseek.com) and write it to `~/.config/dsh-crew/.env`: ``` DEEPSEEK_API_KEY=sk-... ``` ### Verify ```bash node scripts/smoke.mjs ``` The smoke test dispatches one cheap job through whichever path is available — the hub when a DSH instance is running, s

plugins.description: 策略声明 vs 实际执行：说好不干的事干了没，干了的有没有说
plugins.readme_text:
# @deepwhale-cn/dsh-agent-policy

**说好不干的事干了没，干了的有没有说。**

**关键词**：策略声明 · agent 权限 · 一致性核对 · 不出网 · 通配符放权 · 人工确认 · 过度代理 · 最小权限

---

## 先说清楚它是什么、不是什么

**是**：把项目的**策略声明**和**实际代码**摆在一起比 —— 策略文件（`policy.yml` / `agent.yml` / 权限配置）写了什么，代码里是不是真的那么干。

**不是**：
- ❌ **不是运行时拦截** —— 不拦请求、不挡工具调用，只做静态比对
- ❌ **不是权限扫描器** —— 单看「权限是不是太宽」是 `dsh-agent-scope` 的活；这里只问「和声明对得上吗」
- ❌ **不是合规认证** —— 不判断你能不能过审
- ❌ **不下「安全 / 不安全」的结论** —— 只列事实：声明说 A，代码里是 B

**一句话分界**：
```
agent-scope   = 单看【权限本身】宽不宽（通配符、根目录、无限制出网）
agent-policy  = 看【声明】与【实现】是否一致 —— 说好不干的事干了没
```

同一个 `allow: "*"`，两边都可能提；但 agent-scope 说的是「这权限太宽」，agent-policy 说的是「你声明了允许一切，而你大概以为自己在声明白名单」。

---

## 它查什么（5 条）

| 规则 | 查什么 | 级别 |
|---|---|---|
| `POLICY-EGRESS-PROMISE` | 策略里写了「不出网」，同一项目里却有网络调用 | 🔴 |
| `POLICY-CONFIRM-MISSING` | 代码里写着「需人工确认」，同一文件里却直接执行高风险动作 | 🔴 |
| `POLICY-WILDCARD-ALLOW` | 策略里把权限写成通配符（`allow: "*"` / `tools: ["*"]` / `permissions: all`）| 🔴 |
| `POLICY-DECL-EMPTY` | 策略声明里的工具清单是空的（`tools: []` / `tools: null`）| 🟡 |
| `POLICY-NO-DECLARATION` | 有 agent 代码（调模型 / 工具）却找不到任何策略声明文件 | 🟡 |

**每条都会给出：哪个文件、第几行、那行长什么样、依据是哪条标准。**

### 第 5 条为什么带 `when`

`POLICY-NO-DECLARATION` 是「找不到」类判据，如果对所有项目都跑，一个只有 `index.js` 的普通小工具也会被报「没有策略声明」——那是误报。所以它只在项目里出现 agent 特征时才跑：`openai` / `anthropic` / `@deepseek-ai` / `tool_call` / `tool_use` / `AgentExecutor` 等。看到 `notApplicable` 里有它，说明这个项目没有 agent 代码，本来就不该跑。

---

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @deepwhale-cn/dsh-agent-policy
```

## 用法

```bash
# 核对一个项目
dsh-agent-policy --root /path/to/your-agent

# 看内置演示（一个「策略说不出网、代码里却在往外发」的假项目）
dsh-agent-policy --demo

# 列出规则与依据
dsh-agent-policy --list-rules

# 出 HTML 报告 / 给 CI 用
dsh-agent-policy --root . --html
dsh-agent-policy --root . --json
```

退出码：有 high 命中 → `1`（可以挂 CI 卡口）。

---

## 一个例子

`policy.yml` 里写着：

```yaml
outbound:
  allow: false
  note: 本 agent 不出网，只访问内网工单库
```

而 `src/sync.js` 里：

```js
const WEBHOOK = 'https://hooks.slack.com/services/T000/B000/XXXX';
export async function pushSummary(items) {
  const res = await fetch(WEBHOOK, { ... });
}
```

报出来是这样：

```
POLICY-EGRESS-PROMISE  src/sync.js:9
  策略里写明了不准出网，同一个项目里却有网络调用
```

**注意**：这不是说「出网就有罪」。是说到时候出事，大家会拿着这份 `policy.yml` 说「我们规定了不出网」——而实际上它在出。改代码或者改声明，让两边对上，是这份报告唯一的诉求。

---

## 判据出处

- **OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications 2025 · LLM06 Excessive Agency** —— 智能体的能力应与其声明的边界一致；human-in-the-loop 控制
- **CIS Controls v8 · Control 6（Access Control Management）** —— 授权必须显式列出，最小权限
- **NIST AI RMF 1.0 · GOVERN 1.1 / 1.2、MANAGE 2.2、MAP 1.1** —— AI 系统的策略、责任与边界应明确且与执行一致
- **NIST SP 800-53 Rev.5 · AC-6 Least Privilege**

---

## 双向验证

```bash
bash tests/run.sh
```

- 正例 `tests/fixtures/fail/demo-project/`：一个有策略文件、但代码处处和它拧着的客服 agent
- 反例 `tests/fixtures/pass/clean-project/`：策略和实现逐条对得上的项目
- 空缺样本 `tests/fixtures/absent/minimal/`：有 agent 代码、完全没有策略文件

## 许可

MIT

---

## 深鲸网安守护系列（共 31 个）

> 一个插件做一件事。**安全问题是链式的** —— 配套用才完整。

**国内合规** ｜ [等保对照](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-mlps) · [日志留存](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-log-retention) · [备案公示](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-filing) · [用户同意](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-consent-guard) · [个人信息权利](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-rights) · [未成年人保护](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-minor-guard) · [影响评估](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-pipia) · [数据分类分级](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-classify) · [算法备案](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-algorithm-filing) · [数据出境](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-data-export) · [国密合规](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-crypto) · [AI 内容标识](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-ai-labeling)

**AI 与 Agent 治理** ｜ [AI 输出信任](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-ai-output-trust) · [外部内容信任](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-content-trust) · [MCP 安全](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-mcp-audit) · [Agent 权限](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-agent-scope) · [**策略核对**](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-agent-policy) · [可疑指令](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-phishing-guard)

**数据与凭据** ｜ [敏感数据](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-scan) · [密钥轮换](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-key-rotate) · [数据留存](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-lifecycle) · [配置审计](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-env-audit) · [密钥扫描](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-secret-scan)

**供应链与构建** ｜ [开源许可](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-license-guard) · [依赖投毒](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-dep-audit) · [CI 安全](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-ci-guard) · [工具审查](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-tool-vet) · [物料清单](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-sbom)

**权限与应急** ｜ [最小权限](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-least-privilege) · [告警外发](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-alert-relay) · [应急证据包](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-incident-package)

都在 DSH 插件市场（dsh-plugin.org）、npm 和 deepwhale.org.cn/guard.html 上。

plugins.description: Noema long-term memory plugin for DSH: durable, inspectable agent memory with recall tools and a settings page.
plugins.readme_text:
DSH Noema

Long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness — durable, inspectable agent memory backed by Noema.
Recall Before Work • Import From 9 Agent Tools • Settings-Page Memory Management • Crash Keep-Alive • Hot Reload

npm: @zseven-w/dsh-noema · Tested with DSH 0.2.0-rc.2

English · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Français · Español · Deutsch · Português · Русский · हिन्दी · Türkçe · ไทย · Tiếng Việt · Bahasa Indonesia


The Noema Memory settings page — import sources, memory management, and live server status

## Why DSH Noema DSH Noema connects [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) with [Noema](https://github.com/ZSeven-W/noema) — a local-first, non-vector memory system for coding agents — so an Agent keeps durable knowledge across sessions instead of starting every conversation from zero.
### 🧠 Durable Recall Memories persist as inspectable Markdown files under `NOEMA_ROOT` (default `~/.agent-memory/`). `noema_recall` loads relevant context at the start of a session; `noema_search`, `noema_browse`, `noema_catalog`, and `noema_recall_graph` cover lookup, exploration, and auditing. ### 📥 Import From Other Tools `noema_import` reads the memory files of ten other AI coding tools — Codex, Claude Code, opencode, Cursor, Grok, WorkBuddy, Antigravity, Trae, Qoder, Hermes — splits them into sections, and saves each as a durable memory. A content-keyed ledger deduplicates across runs and across tools that share files.
### 🛠️ Settings-Page Management The Noema Memory settings page configures the server command, memory root, budgets, idle/call timeouts, and the guidance section — and a Manage memories card searches, browses, adds, reviews, and deletes stored memories directly. ### 🩺 Keep-Alive The memory server stays up: idle timeout defaults to never, and a keep-alive loop restarts the `noema-mcp` child in the background when it crashes or exits, with a configurable check interval and restart backoff.
### 🔍 Smart Entity Extraction Noema's extraction engine combines jieba word segmentation with high-precision signals — English proper nouns, CJK names and technical terms, quoted topics, and repetition — with stopword and path filters, so the PageIndex topic catalog stays clean. ### ⚡ Hot Reload After the first boot, the plugin never needs a restart again: `pnpm run build` hot-reloads the host plugin through Cordis HMR, and `ppnpm run build:client` hot-swaps the browser bundle over the client-hmr SSE channel.
## Install into DSH ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add @zseven-w/dsh-noema@latest dsh web ``` Or, for local development straight from the source tree: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-noema dsh web ``` The `link:` protocol symlinks the profile dependency to this repository, so rebuilds are visible immediately and Cordis HMR can watch the compiled output. The plugin bundles the `noema-mcp` binary through per-platform optional npm packages. To build it yourself instead, run `cargo build --release -p noema-mcp` inside the bundled `noema` submodule, or point the Server command setting at any `noema-mcp` build. ## Memory Tools The model-facing tools mirror the Noema MCP surface: | Tool | What it does | | --- | --- | | `noema_recall` | Recall relevant memories for a query, with a token budget. | | `noema_search` | Full-text search over stored memories. | | `noema_browse` | Browse the PageIndex catalog for a topic or entity. | | `noema_catalog` | Render the full memory catalog as markdown. | | `noema_recall_graph` | Multi-hop recall through links and shared entities. | | `noema_neighbors` | One graph hop from a memory. | | `noema_explain` | Explain why a memory was or was not recalled. | | `noema_remember` | Save a durable fact, decision, constraint, or preference. | | `noema_review_list` | List pending review candidates. | | `noema_review_decide` | Accept, reject, edit, or merge a candidate. | | `noema_forget` | Tombstone or hard-delete a memory. | | `noema_policy_get` / `noema_policy_set` | Read or update the write policy. | | `noema_status` | Server and tenant status: counts, index health, storage root. | | `noema_import` | Import memories from other AI coding tools. | Each tool returns a uniform envelope `{ ok, tool, text }` where `text` carries the full server output. ## Import memories from other tools | Source id | Global files | Workspace files | | --- | --- | --- | | `codex` | `~/.codex/AGENTS.md` + the Codex memory pipeline: `~/.codex/memories/MEMORY.md`, plugins.description: DSH 技能 local-solution-first v0.1.6：动手前先搜本地已有方案，并用证据验证是否可安全复用。
plugins.readme_text:
# local-solution-first

一个给 **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)** 用的 Skill：在动手实现、移植、选依赖、排查工具之前，
**先在本机检索有没有现成的、可复用的东西**，并且用证据说话 —— 证据不足就不强行复用，
而是明确写出"为什么这次不该复用"。

> 技能本身是**行为规程**，不是工具：不新增任何权限、不注册任何 MCP 工具，
> 只约束 Agent 的分析顺序和报告结构。仓库另外带一层很薄的插件包装，
> 唯一作用是把这个技能注册进 DSH（见下方「安装」）。

---

## 它解决什么问题

Agent 最常见的浪费是"重新发明已经有轮子的车"：本机已经装着同类插件、Skill、脚本、
依赖或源码，Agent 却直接开始写新实现。这个 Skill 要求把顺序倒过来：

1. **先定检索范围**，按分层从"最可能被复用"的位置往外搜；
2. **再逐个候选取证**，用可核对的事实（路径、版本、能力、代价）而不是印象；
3. **给出建议**，包括"复用 / 部分复用 / 不复用 / 需要更多信息"四种明确结论；
4. **写清安全与验证**，以及这次结论的**证据边界**（哪些地方没查、为什么没查）。

触发场景：评估一个仓库能不能直接用、把外部项目移植进来、实现新功能前选方案、
挑选依赖、排查本机已有工具、以及"复用它还是自己写"的这类抉择。

## 安装

### 方式 A：作为 DSH 插件安装

本仓库同时是一个 DSH 组合包（bundle）。三种装法任选：

```powershell
dsh plugin add github:shenhe3939-debug/local-solution-first
```

- 或在桌面端 Web 侧边栏的**插件**页安装并启用它；
- 或让 Agent 用 `plugin_manager` 工具安装（该操作需要 `danger-full-access` 或逐次批准）。
组合包在 profile 依赖里的名字就是 `@shenhe3939-debug/local-solution-first`：所有 bundle 都按
**包名**记录在 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里，`cordis.patch.yml` 中 `insert` 的 `name` 必须与它一致
才会被装载（该字段是宿主 import 的模块指示符，不能写成相对路径）；
改配置后启用 HMR 的 profile 立即生效，否则等重启。

> **这条结论的强度边界（as-of 2026-10-17）**：装载链路里除「真机 `dsh plugin add`」以外的
> 每一环都在 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 上实测过（读宿主源码 + 真实注册表装载 + 指示符解析，见下方
> 「打包自检」）；但**没有**在一台真实 DSH profile 上跑过 `dsh plugin add` 并看它装载生效 ——
> 记录这些证据的机器以 app.asar 便携形态运行 DSH，本机隔离沙箱工具直接拒绝
> （`no DeepSeek Harness desktop installation found`）。所以此处「可安装」=
> **契约级 + 运行时级已证，安装器端到端未证**。

启用后，`cordis.patch.yml` 会把 `lib/index.mjs` 挂进组合，由它在 `ctx.skills.register`
上注册本技能（`source: bundled`，资源基目录指向包根，所以 `references/`、`tests/`
照常可被引用）。技能正文由 `scripts/build-skill-content.mjs` 从 `SKILL.md` 生成到
`lib/skill-content.mjs`，与从目录发现的同名技能**逐字节相同**（都是去掉 frontmatter
再 trim 的正文）——改了 `SKILL.md` 记得重跑一次生成脚本。包版本号跟随它包装的技能版本。

### 方式 B：作为普通 skill 目录

DSH 的 Skill 发现规则（源码与实测确认，DSH 0.2.0-rc.2）：

- 只发现**一层**：`<root>/<skill-name>/SKILL.md`，`**/SKILL.md` 这种嵌套路径**不会**被发现；
- 多个根目录**优先级数字小的赢**：
  `项目 .dsh/skills` 100 < `项目 .agents/skills` 200 < `运行时 provider` 250 <
  `自定义目录` 300 < `用户 .dsh/skills` 400 < `用户 .agents/skills` 500 < `内置` 600。

所以**同名副本只有优先级高的那个生效**，用户级副本会被项目级副本遮蔽。

克隆到任一 skill 根目录下、目录名保持 `local-solution-first` 即可：

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/shenhe3939-debug/local-solution-first.git `
  "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\skills\local-solution-first"
```

也可以直接用随仓库附带的冻结发行包 `dist/local-solution-first-dsh-v0.1.6.zip`
（解压后是 `local-solution-first/` 目录，放进任一 skill 根目录即可）：

- 发行页：https://github.com/shenhe3939-debug/local-solution-first/releases/tag/v0.1.6
- 直链（钉在 tag 上，内容不随 `main` 变动）：
  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shenhe3939-debug/local-solution-first/v0.1.6/dist/local-solution-first-dsh-v0.1.6.zip

## 仓库内容

| 路径 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `SKILL.md` | Skill 本体：触发条件、10 条硬规则、工作流、报告结构、DSH 环境事实 |
| `package.json` | DSH 组合包清单：`dsh.bundle.patch` 指向 `cordis.patch.yml` |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | 组合包补丁：把插件挂进组合（`insert` 一行） |
| `lib/index.mjs` | 插件入口：在 `ctx.skills.register` 上注册本技能 |
| `lib/skill-content.mjs` | 由 `SKILL.md` 生成的技能正文（构建产物，勿手改） |
| `scripts/build-skill-content.mjs` | 生成上一行：拆 frontmatter、trim 正文、写入 SHA-256 |
| `scripts/verify-package.mjs` | 打包自检：在 clone 里核对冻结指纹、bundle 清单、补丁形状、注册载荷与资源可解析性（无外部依赖） |
| `references/compatibility-checklist.md` | 复用前的能力/兼容性核对清单（含 provider/plugin skill 根 250 档） |
| `references/decision-matrix.md` | "复用 / 部分复用 / 不复用"的判定矩阵 |
| `references/validator-design.md` | 验证器设计：怎样算查到了、怎样算没查 |
| `tests/regression-protocol.md` | 回归协议：探针格式、输出卫生、硬性阳性对照的要求 |
| `tests/regression-cases.md` | 13 个用例 LS-01 … LS-13 |
| `tests/regression-run-*.md` | 历次回归记录（run #1 … run #9，另有一次 priority-probe，均 2026-10-16） |
| `CHANGELOG.md` | 版本沿革与冻结策略 |
| `LICENSE` | MIT 许可证 |
| `dist/local-solution-first-dsh-v0.1.6.zip` | v0.1.6 冻结发行包 |

## 版本与验证状态（as-of 记录）

- **当前冻结版本：v0.1.6（2026-10-17）**，`SKILL.md` 自 v0.1.4 起逐字节未变
  （SHA-256 `F6E1E40495998A07DF0F32A6EDC0B81AB07CABEB6148D974A8A456380D1A915D`）。
- **发行包指纹**：`dist/local-solution-first-dsh-v0.1.6.zip`，159,602 字节，
  SHA-256 `1360F7DFC5C014B46D170CDDD4D922D543CB0A90D64101423E4CFE272CC140E6`。
  本仓库根目录下的包文件就是该 zip 解压出来的逐字节内容。
- **最终回归 run #10（2026-10-17）**：behavioral **13/13 PASS**（mandatory subset 7/7）；
  run protocol **COMPLIANT**（1 处 deviation，D-T1 未复现）；run-level release gate **PASSED**。
  该记录产生于安装期、留在本地安装目录，**不在本冻结包内**（包内保留到 run #9）。
- **冻结策略**：只有三种情形开 v0.1.7 —— DSH 升级、实际观察到 Skill 行为错误、
  或明确新增功能。

> 本项目的记录纪律：状态一律写成**带日期的 as-of 证据**，不用现在时断言，
> 也不回改历史条目；新条目覆盖旧条目。`tests/` 里的历史记录保持原样。

### 仓库侧的字节一致性与打包自检

- **`.gitattributes` 固定 LF**：Git for Windows 默认 `core.autocrlf=true`。没有这条规则时，
  clone 出来的 `SKILL.md` 会被改写成 CRLF（12,971 B，SHA-256 `85add11f…`），与冻结指纹不符；
  现在 `* text=auto eol=lf`（`*.zip` 视作二进制），任何平台的 checkout 都与冻结包逐字节相同。
- **打包自检**：在本仓库内执行 `node scripts/verify-package.mjs`（除 Node 本身无任何依赖），
  逐项核对 —— `SKILL.md` 与 `dist/*.zip` 命中冻结指纹；`package.json` 声明 `dsh.bundle.patch`，
  补丁文件是约定形状（`insert.name` 等于包名、不是相对路径）；`files[]` 里每个路径都存在；
  `lib/index.mjs` 注册且只注册一个技能（名字合法、`source: bundled`、正文与 `SKILL.md` 去掉
  frontmatter 后逐字节相同、资源基目录就是包根），且没有技能注册表时只是空操作、不抛错。
- **宿主侧实测（2026-10-17）**：把 DSH 自带实现中的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill` 真实 `SkillRegistry`
  挂到真实 cordis 组合上，再按 bundle 的装载方式挂本插件 —— **14/14 通过**：技能出现在宿主目录、
  按名可加载、正文与 `SKILL.md` 正文一致、`provider: runtime`、渲染出
  `<skill_content name="local-solution-first">`，同名重复注册只是空操作、不会顶掉已生效的那个。
- **装载指示符解析实测（2026-10-17）**：按宿主的解析算法（`packageDirFromAnchor`）在 profile 形状的
  锚点上验证 —— `createRequire("<profile>/package.json").resolve("@shenhe3939-debug/local-solution-first")`
  落到 `lib/index.mjs`；`node_modules/@shenhe3939-debug/local-solution-first/package.json` 的 `name`
  与 `cordis.patch.yml` 里 `insert.name` 一致，`dsh.bundle.patch` 指向的文件存在；
  `lib/` 内**没有非 `node:` 的裸导入**，因此模块不依赖宿主的 import map 就能加载
  （对照：本机真实 profile 里已安装且在用的 `@wxg-prc-cpg/browser-skill-dsh-plugin` 需要
  `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` 等宿主包，脱离 DSH 进程单独 import 会 `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND`）。
- **构建可复现**：在 clone 里重跑 `node scripts/build-skill-content.mjs`，`git status` 干净。

## 许可证

MIT，全文见仓库根目录的 [`LICENSE`](LICENSE)。

Copyright (c) 2026 shenhe3939-debug

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-fa-rtl

**Right-to-left display for Persian (Farsi) chat messages in the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.**

[فارسی](README.fa.md) | English

Persian answers from the model — and your own Persian messages — render right-to-left and right-aligned, while English paragraphs, code blocks, and tables keep their original left-to-right layout. It is a pure DSH plugin: no modification to the application's files, no build toolchain, nothing to configure after install.

## How it works

Every chat row DSH ships is laid out left-to-right (LTR); Persian text inside it is bidi-reordered by the Unicode algorithm, but the *base direction* stays LTR — so Persian paragraphs stay left-aligned and punctuation drifts to the wrong edge.

The web-standard fix is `dir="auto"`. Since plugins cannot touch the React-rendered DOM, this plugin uses its exact CSS equivalent:

```css
unicode-bidi: plaintext;
text-align: start;
```

`unicode-bidi: plaintext` (CSS Writing Modes 4) lets **each text block** choose its own direction from the block's first strong character — a paragraph starting with Persian renders RTL and right-aligns; a paragraph starting with English is unchanged. Consequences:

- Mixed answers (Persian prose + code + tables) render correctly: prose RTL, `<pre>` code deliberately untouched (stays LTR), table cells per-cell, list markers flip with their list.
- The selector scopes only to stable `data-*` attributes that `dsh-client-ui-chat` emits on its flow items (`data-chat-flow-kind`, `data-chat-group-part`, `data-turn-process-answer`). Build-time hashed class names are never referenced, so the plugin survives UI updates. If an attribute ever changes, the CSS simply stops matching — it cannot break the app.

## Install

Requires DSH ≥ 0.2.0-rc.2 with a web composition (`desktop` or `web` profile). Any Chromium/Electron ≥ 105 works.

### From the DSH Web UI

Open the **Plugins** page in the sidebar and install the bundle from this repository's GitHub address (`github:mehdinikzad68/dsh-fa-rtl`). Installation runs `pnpm` in the profile directory and enables the bundle by default.

### From the CLI

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:mehdinikzad68/dsh-fa-rtl
# or, for the web profile:
dsh plugin --profile web add github:<owner>/dsh-fa-rtl
```

Installation normally enables the bundle automatically; if not, toggle it on from the Plugins page. Restart the app once if your profile applies patches only at startup.

### From an agent session

Ask the agent to use the `plugin_manager` tool with action `install_bundle` and the GitHub spec. Each management call requires your approval.

### Local development (no installation)

Clone the repo and point a profile patch row at the **module file** (ESM cannot import a directory). In `<profile-dir>/cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: fa-rtl
      name: 'C:\path\to\dsh-fa-rtl\lib\index.js'
```

## Verify

1. Ask the model something in Persian — the Persian text renders RTL and right-aligned; numbers and punctuation sit correctly; code stays LTR.
2. Browser console (or DevTools) shows: `[dsh-fa-rtl] active — Persian chat text now renders right-to-left`
3. `<head>` contains a `<style data-plugin="dsh-fa-rtl">` tag.
4. Settings → Plugins shows no synchronization error for the bundle.

## Uninstall

Remove the bundle from the Plugins page or with `dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove dsh-fa-rtl` (installed route), or delete the `fa-rtl` insert block from `cordis.patch.yml` (local route). The module system removes the plugin's stylesheet when the entry is disabled.

## Package layout

```
dsh-fa-rtl/
├── package.json        # manifest: dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client declaration
├── cordis.patch.yml    # bundle patch: registers the fa-rtl Loader row on install
├── lib/index.js        # Host half (Node): imports cleanly, mounts as a Cordis plugin
├── lib/client.js       # Client half (browser): hand-written DSH client bundle, injects CSS
├── README.md / README.fa.md
└── LICENSE             # MIT
```

## Extend

- Want more surfaces RTL (e.g. `ask_user_question` cards)? Widen the scope selector list in [`lib/client.js`](lib/client.js) and save — HMR hot-swaps the bundle, or restart once.
- Want *forced* RTL for everything (even English text)? Replace `unicode-bidi: plaintext` with `direction: rtl` in the same file.

## Known limitations

- A paragraph that *starts* with a Latin word (e.g. «VS Code را نصب کن») resolves LTR in auto mode — the same behavior as `dir="auto"` everywhere on the web; the Persian runs inside still order correctly.
- Overflowing wide tables keep their physical margins; very wide Persian tables may align slightly differently.
- Question cards (`ask_user_question`) and some side bars are intentionally out of scope for v1.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)
